"""Read the already received original closeout log; never execute product code."""
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import re
from datetime import datetime, timezone

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
INPUT = ROOT / "round32-PR199-closeout-original-intake"
OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SOURCE = "4786c1457b47c5baf4c09d32b96048795e863111"

def identity(path):
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(path), "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            "git_blob": hashlib.sha1(b"blob " + str(len(data)).encode() + b"\0" + data).hexdigest()}

paths = [INPUT / n for n in ["114082032026-original-closeout.log", "original-run.json", "original-jobs.json", "official-original-responses.json"]]
before = [identity(p) for p in paths]
assert before[0]["bytes"] == 1913829
assert before[0]["sha256"] == "da3fa6474b1682836b8f88cd09c7375b8bade1c3fcc6ecea225cc6222c93cca3"
assert before[0]["git_blob"] == "e9c4003615f8af33330bfb149f829096a27b6703"
run = json.loads(paths[1].read_text())
jobs = json.loads(paths[2].read_text())["jobs"]
job, = [j for j in jobs if j["id"] == 114082032026]
assert run["id"] == job["run_id"] == 38008269601
assert run["head_sha"] == job["head_sha"] == SOURCE
assert job["status"] == "completed" and job["conclusion"] == "success"
assert all(s["conclusion"] == "success" for s in job["steps"])
raw = paths[0].read_text().splitlines()
lines = [re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m", "", re.sub(r"^\S+Z ", "", l)) for l in raw]

def excerpt(a, b):
    return [{"line": i, "text": lines[i-1]} for i in range(a, b+1)]

assert lines[192] == SOURCE
assert "git log -1 --format=%H" in lines[191]
assert "set -o pipefail" in lines[1516]
summary_re = re.compile(r"test result: (\w+)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured; (\d+) filtered out; finished in ([\d.]+)s")
target = None
footers = []
ignored = []
for i, text in enumerate(lines, 1):
    if re.match(r"\s*Running (?:unittests|tests/)", text):
        target = {"line": i, "text": text.strip()}
    m = summary_re.fullmatch(text)
    if m:
        item = dict(zip(["status", "passed", "failed", "ignored", "measured", "filtered_out", "seconds"], m.groups()))
        for k in ["passed", "failed", "ignored", "measured", "filtered_out"]:
            item[k] = int(item[k])
        item["seconds"] = float(item["seconds"])
        item.update(line=i, preceding_target=target)
        item["nested_child_footer"] = bool(target and "cc_server-" in target["text"] and item["filtered_out"] == 355)
        assert item["status"] == "ok" and item["failed"] == 0
        footers.append(item)
    if re.match(r"test \S+ \.\.\. ignored(?:,|$)", text):
        ignored.append({"line": i, "text": text, "preceding_target": target})

features = []
for feature, start, end, count, command_range in [
    ("default", 2037, 2307, 8, (1518,1519)),
    ("semantic", 2331, 2631, 9, (1520,1522)),
    ("semantic-http", 3527, 3933, 12, (1525,1528)),
]:
    assert "Running tests/p7_v18_parameter_contract.rs" in lines[start-1]
    footer, = [f for f in footers if f["line"] == end]
    assert footer["passed"] == count and all(footer[k] == 0 for k in ["failed", "ignored", "measured", "filtered_out"])
    methods = []
    for i in range(start, end):
        m = re.fullmatch(r"test (\S+) \.\.\. ok", lines[i-1])
        if m: methods.append({"line": i, "method": m.group(1)})
    assert len(methods) == len({m["method"] for m in methods}) == count
    features.append({"features": feature, "command": excerpt(*command_range), "target_line": start,
                     "executable": lines[start-1].strip(), "footer": footer, "methods_passed": methods})
ready = "loopback::ready_publication_status_keeps_request_policy_and_per_query_coverage_distinct"
assert {x["features"] for x in features if ready in [m["method"] for m in x["methods_passed"]]} == {"semantic-http"}
assert lines[3680] == "test " + ready + " ... ok"
assert not any("--ignored" in l for l in lines if l.startswith("cargo test "))
assert "assert json.loads((out / 'source-before.json').read_text()) == after" == lines[4145]
assert '"passed": true' in lines[4058] and '"error": null' in lines[4058]
assert len([f for f in footers if f["nested_child_footer"]]) == 11

report = {
    "schema_version": 1, "reviewer": "/root/pr_triage", "created_at_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    "status": "accepted_scoped_original_closeout_log", "source": SOURCE, "run_id": run["id"], "run_attempt": run["run_attempt"],
    "job": {k: job[k] for k in ["id", "name", "status", "conclusion", "started_at", "completed_at", "head_sha"]},
    "review_scope": "Read-only original log and official job metadata; no network, test, product, validator or artifact download performed by this reader.",
    "independence": "Original executor is GitHub Actions. Reviewer did not run this job and is not the V18 synchronization fix author (root); reviewer previously integrated the independent borrowed-oracle donor and does not claim a new independent source review here.",
    "original_inputs": before, "raw_log_line_count": len(raw),
    "actual_checkout": {"kind": "direct head checkout", "commit": SOURCE, "proof": excerpt(190,193), "not_test_merge": "d51e4d4ad298b2f883225fd847c5fe213cc53bc7"},
    "toolchain": {"proof": excerpt(448,454), "build_kind": "debug/test isolated closeout target; not cold release performance"},
    "official_job_steps": job["steps"],
    "v18_feature_executions": features,
    "v18_counts_boundary": "8, 9 and 12 are feature-separated target executions with overlapping method names; not 29 unique controls. The repaired ready-publication method actually passed only in semantic-http, at raw line 3681.",
    "all_observed_test_result_footers": footers,
    "footer_counting_boundary": "Preserve every footer without summing unique tests. Eleven 1-pass/355-filtered footers are subprocess results nested in the semantic-http cc-server lib execution; its own final footer is 343 passed / 13 ignored.",
    "original_ignored_method_records": ignored,
    "filtered_or_probe_boundary": {"semantic_config_filtered": 85, "cc_eval_resource_target_filtered": 74,
        "cc_eval_resource_only_command": excerpt(4062,4064),
        "borrowed_correctness_or_ignored_cost_probe_credit_from_this_job": False,
        "explanation": "The cc-eval lib command filters to self_usage_has_direct_identity_and_monotonic_cpu_without_procfs_lookup. No ignored borrowed cost probe was requested; ignored entries remain ignored even where original parent tests invoke an owned subprocess."},
    "producer_source_checks": {"before_snapshot_command": excerpt(459,465), "after_snapshot_command": excerpt(4139,4147),
        "official_before_and_after_steps_success": True,
        "boundary": "The successful producer executed its original source equality assertion. No separate before/after snapshot bytes from its artifact were downloaded or independently traversed here."},
    "other_original_control_boundaries": {
        "http_product_lifecycle": "Official original step 7 succeeded after the logged semantic-http debug product build, original lifecycle driver binding and invocation; no separate binary/build JSON or 13-checkpoint raw artifact was independently received in this review.",
        "fault_lifecycle_final_stdout": {"line":4059,"text":lines[4058]},
        "fault_lifecycle_observed_seeds": sorted({json.loads(l)["seed"] for l in lines[4034:4058] if l.startswith('{') and '"kind": "phase"' in l}),
        "original_guard_v15_claim": "This closeout job does not substitute for the separately running/received main source-admission job."},
    "artifact_upload_reported_by_producer_only": {"id":11652742014, "name":"p7-closeout-"+SOURCE, "bytes":20518217,
        "sha256":"3528b35d04305dc54452d4636da4f1775d2d72fd63bd0c312fca1a8db994ae75", "proof":excerpt(4188,4194),
        "downloaded_or_crc_checked_by_this_review":False},
    "retained_failure": {"source":"f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a", "run_id":38004132959,"job_id":114068898390,
        "log_git_blob":"3efadf710a054e2beda886cdd29938639145e94b", "boundary":"Earlier 11-pass/1-failure V18 donor execution remains historical failure; this new source success neither rewrites nor reruns it."},
    "whole_pr_ci_green": False, "whole_pr_ci_boundary": "No inference from this one completed job about main, runtime, soak or all PR checks. Root observes their independent current state.",
    "todo_credit": 0,
}
after = [identity(p) for p in paths]
assert before == after
report["original_inputs_before_after_equal"] = True
dest = OUT / "independent-closeout-log-review.json"
dest.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({"status":report["status"], "report":identity(dest), "v18_passed":[x["footer"]["passed"] for x in features], "footers":len(footers), "ignored_records":len(ignored), "original_inputs_before_after_equal":True}, sort_keys=True))
